summary: Bug fix verification: send_admin_notification function was added to server.py. Order cancellation endpoint POST /api/orders/{order_id}/cancel now works correctly. All 7 frontend tests pass, 8 backend tests pass (1 skipped due to no pending orders after cancellation test).

issues.description: MailerSend email sending is working technically (returns message ID) but emails may not be delivered because groupeyamaplus.com domain is not verified in MailerSend dashboard. User needs to verify their domain in MailerSend settings and add DNS records (SPF, DKIM) at Hostinger for emails to be delivered.

cancel_modal_ui.details: Cancel button visible for pending orders, modal opens with reason selection, confirm button disabled until reason selected
